# ArabiMalayalam

> ArabiMalayalam is a free, privacy-first online keyboard and transliterator for writing Malayalam in Arabi-Malayalam script. It accepts Manglish, Malayalam Unicode, and Arabic input, supports full sentences and paragraphs, and works as an installable offline Progressive Web App.

Arabi-Malayalam (അറബി-മലയാളം / اَرَبِ مَلَیَالَمْ) is an adapted Arabic writing system used for Malayalam, especially in the Mappila literary tradition of Kerala's Malabar region. The keyboard provides ranked suggestions rather than semantic autocomplete. User documents and learned selections stay in browser storage unless an explicitly configured transliteration provider is used.

## Use the keyboard

- [Open the Arabi-Malayalam keyboard](https://arabi-malayalam.cvsuhail.online/): Type or paste Manglish, Malayalam, or Arabic and receive Arabi-Malayalam suggestions.
- [How to type Arabi-Malayalam](https://arabi-malayalam.cvsuhail.online/how-to-type-arabi-malayalam): Step-by-step instructions, common Manglish examples, paragraph paste, and mobile installation.
- [What is Arabi-Malayalam?](https://arabi-malayalam.cvsuhail.online/about-arabi-malayalam): Concise background, representative letters, and an explanation of the script.

## Machine-readable resources

- [Arabi-Malayalam guide in Markdown](https://arabi-malayalam.cvsuhail.online/arabi-malayalam-guide.md): Clean text describing the project, supported inputs, sample spellings, privacy, and limitations.
- [XML sitemap](https://arabi-malayalam.cvsuhail.online/sitemap.xml): Canonical indexable pages.
- [Web app manifest](https://arabi-malayalam.cvsuhail.online/manifest.webmanifest): Installable PWA metadata.
